rationale:
bugs_open/238 §11.12, owner-authorised 2026-08-21 ("please go ahead and do both"). THE LIVE DEFECT, found only by fetching the served page — no row-level census could see it: `
` on 6 deployed rows across 3 sites. That is bugs_open/238's own defect class — an UNGATED field inside an attribute rendering empty — on href= instead of src=. TWO CAUSES, so two halves, and either alone leaves a site broken. (a) THE SOURCE IS UNREACHABLE: contact_phone declares site_specs.contact.phone and contact_location declares site_specs.contact.address, while resolveSpecAlias step 2 is hard-gated (`if aspect != "identity" { return nil, false }`) and siteRowIdentityColumns maps phone->phone and address->contact_address. Identical to the mismatch migration 525 fixed for contact_email the same day. Repointing ALONE fixes exactly one site: leopardessconsulting.co.uk has a number; robot-hands.com and gamesdesign.co.uk have none in either store and would keep serving the dead control. (b) THE TEMPLATE IS UNGATED: a site with no phone should render no phone row at all. That is RFC_009's option C, which the owner has already chosen once — migration 295 gated 68 ungated fields on 2026-08-03 for exactly this reason. Gating ALONE fixes all three sites' dead control but leaves leopardess's real number unpublished. Hence both. THE GATE WRAPS THE WHOLE cb-detail-item, NOT THE VALUE, and that is the load-bearing detail: each item is icon + label + value, so gating only the value leaves an icon and a heading standing over nothing — bugs_closed/111 exactly ("footer contact heading renders over an empty mailto"). The standing LANDMINE on on_missing:skip_field makes the general point: read what ENCLOSES the field and gate the smallest VALID unit, because a field in a fixed-arity row is either a no-op to gate or emits malformed HTML. ALL THREE items are gated, including the email 525 just repointed: gamesdesign has no email either, so leaving that one ungated would ship `` on its next rebuild — the same defect one attribute over. ON THE NUMBER, because publishing a phone is not a technical act: bugs_closed/140 already traced +44 (0) 7934 524 911 across six sites and established it is the OWNER'S OWN, correctly propagated, recording "whether six businesses should share one number" as an owner question rather than a defect. It was put to him again here and authorised.

edits.rationale: Both halves in one migration because either alone leaves a site serving a defect, and splitting them would put a half-fix on the fleet between applies. Pre-flight asserts the single active row, BOTH current sources, and the exact cb-details block verbatim — a replace() that matches nothing is a silent no-op reporting success. Verify counts the three gates, asserts the ungated block is GONE, asserts both sources moved, asserts a neighbour field survived (jsonb_set replaces a subtree, so a path typo would drop type/required while the source read fine), and asserts {{end}} balance, because unbalanced gates fail every render of the component.
edits.sketch: BEGIN; DO $guard$ assert 1 active contact-block row (RFC_034 fork rule), contact_phone.source='site_specs.contact.phone', contact_location.source='site_specs.contact.address', and position(<verbatim old cb-details block>) = 1 else RAISE 'the template has changed since 2026-08-21; re-derive, do NOT force' $guard$; UPDATE ... SET html_template = replace(html_template, <old block>, <gated block>), input_schema = jsonb_set(jsonb_set(...,'{fields,contact_phone,source}','"site_specs.identity.phone"',false),'{fields,contact_location,source}','"site_specs.identity.address"',false); DO $verify$ 3 gates, old block absent, both sources moved, contact_phone.type still 'text', >=3 {{end}} $verify$; COMMIT; then a WATCH section giving the expected per-site outcome and the served-page greps.

edits.rationale: A template change to a live component shipped on the strength of a mutation-proved test rather than inspection. Pins the three states that matter and, deliberately, also pins the SIDE EFFECT: a gated field is invisible to missingBareFields, so dead_url_control will never report this component again — asserted so it is a known property rather than a surprise when the detector goes quiet on it.
edits.sketch: const contactBlockDetailsGated = <the exact gated block>; three tests calling RenderTemplate(tmpl, &RenderContext{ContentData: ...}, zap.NewNop()) asserting item counts, absence of `tel:`, absence of orphaned labels, empty inURLAttr, and container survival. Mutation documented in the file header: drop the {{if .contact_phone}}/{{end}} pair and TestContactBlockGate_MissingPhoneRendersNothing fails printing the live defect.

plan.risks: Publishing a phone number is a real-world act, not a config change. Mitigated by provenance rather than assertion: bugs_closed/140 established this number is the owner's own, correctly propagated across his own portfolio sites, and he authorised it again on 2026-08-21. Only leopardess publishes anything — the other two sites have no number and now render nothing rather than a dead link. A template edit to a live component used by 6 pages is the highest-risk part; it is mitigated by a verbatim-block pre-flight (a replace() matching nothing is a silent success), a gate/end-balance verify (unbalanced gates would fail EVERY render of the component), and a mutation-proved Go test against the real renderer. Config is live on apply but the artefact is not: the six pages keep serving the dead tel: until re-rendered, so 'applied' does not equal 'fixed'. The re-renders were queued explicitly and the file's WATCH section carries the served-page verification. Once gated, missingBareFields cannot see these fields, so dead_url_control goes permanently quiet on this component. Correct — nothing is emitted to report — but the silence must not be read as proof the data arrived; check content_data or the page. Recorded in both the migration header and the test. Rollback is NOT symmetrical and its sidecar says so: reverting restores the defect deliberately, and it does not un-render pages already rebuilt — and the PBP-039 carry will re-supply a stored contact_phone on the next build even after the source is un-pointed.
plan.non_scope: Not widening resolveSpecAlias to let any aspect read the sites row — shared-seam, RFC-shaped, and it would take the publish-this-value question fleet-wide in one step. Two components have now been repointed instead. Not touching the six OTHER active components that still declare a site_specs.contact.* source (surfaced by 525's verify NOTICE): four are tool components with ZERO deployed rows (inert), and ai-readiness-quiz's result_cta_primary_url declares contact.cta_url, which siteRowIdentityColumns does not map at all — a different fix. Not addressing the remaining 3 of the 9 residual §11.4 pairs: gamesdesign's cta.primary_url, leopardess's contact.cta_url, and fundamentallyai's six fields its component no longer declares (bugs_open/309's class).
